findings.title: Import attachment loss index can silently omit a failed write
evidence: apps/api/src/imports/service.ts:1693-1705 turns any processImportAttachmentJobs exception into attachment_storage_unavailable losses
apps/api/src/imports/service.ts:1719-1730 suppresses insertImportLossRows failure with catch(() => undefined)
findings.impact: A transient storage failure can be recorded as a permanent loss; if the subsequent per-run index insert fails, the losses API can under-report despite a chunk report. The exact failure sequence is untested here.
findings.backlog: L-06 P6 transient-write-error low; broaden task to loss-index durability
findings.coherent_task: Classify retryable attachment errors; preserve non-loss pending state and retry safely; make loss-index write failure observable and recoverable; test injected storage/DB failures.
findings.dependency: Import-run data/approval semantics and high-tier review; do not rewrite customer data.

findings.title: MC-18 hostile-content journey is mocked rather than persisted
evidence: docs/technical/feature-contracts-p4.md:2789-2794 requires a seeded work item and scripted model through get_work_item
tests/mcp/injection.test.ts:1-25 calls itself a unit slice with no database; :50-145 constructs in-memory workItem and mocked client
No MC-18 or scripted-model journey found under tests/api-integration, tests/e2e or apps/web/e2e-sit by targeted search
findings.impact: MCP wrapper tests cover in-process formatting, but they cannot catch persistence/API serialization or live credential/pending-action regressions across the complete hostile-content path.
findings.backlog: L-07 MC-18; L-03a release regression suite
findings.coherent_task: Add one persisted hostile work-item journey using real API/MCP key and scripted model, covering read-only refusal, bounded write, and pending-action approval boundary.
findings.dependency: Fresh dedicated _test DB and one test owner; no protected live DB.

findings.title: Issued portal attachment URL remains usable after permission revocation until TTL
evidence: apps/api/src/attachment/index.ts:694-724 checks reach then redirects to storage URL
apps/api/src/storage/filesystem.ts:791-832 verifies only object key, expiry and HMAC on download
apps/api/src/storage/s3.ts:353-370 issues a five-minute presigned GET
findings.impact: A previously authorized customer can use an already-issued link for up to five minutes after portal reach changes.
findings.coherent_task: Choose documented accepted expiry window or proxy/revalidate each download; a security-model change requires Thomas approval.
findings.dependency: Owner decision on retained attachment-link contract.
findings.rough_effort: 0.5 day decision; 1-2 days if revalidation implemented

findings.title: Import finalization attachment failure can leave run marked running until manual resume
evidence: apps/api/src/imports/engine/runner.ts:465 calls resumePendingImportAttachments before the try/catch at :469-550
apps/api/src/scheduler/import-run.ts:8-24 says sweep is on demand, not clock-fired
docs/technical/background-jobs.md import-run row says no automatic restart recovery
findings.impact: Failure before finalizer catch can escape without pausedReason; operator must re-kick a still-running run. This is documented behavior but needs explicit recovery coverage/readiness treatment.
findings.backlog: L-06 P6 recovery lows / L-10 customer readiness
findings.coherent_task: Move recoverable finalizer failures into explicit run state, preserve cursor and resume idempotently, test restart and operator recovery.
findings.dependency: Import semantics and job scheduler contract; Thomas approval if retained contract changes.
